semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Enatec provides precision plastic components and processing which are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and processes.
summary: Enatec specializes in the processing of a wide range of plastics, including engineering and super engineering plastics, which are used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Their expertise in precision cutting and bending, supported by advanced machinery, allows them to supply critical plastic components tailored for semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Precision cutting and bending of engineering plastics
Manufacturing of components from heat-resistant super engineering plastics
In-house resin processing for semiconductor equipment
Supply of custom plastic components for semiconductor industry

regional_presence.Japan: Located in Fukui City, Fukui Prefecture, Enatec conducts its manufacturing operations here.
